e2e_allowlist_entries.basis: table rows in e2e/ALLOWLIST.md (prose mentions of CI-A* do not count)
e2e_allowlist_entries.why: governed suppressions, but the register set 10 as the tooling threshold

gates_without_proof.why: gaps.md G8 — 'is it passing' and 'can it fail' are different questions, and mac-build.yml answered the first correctly for three months while being incapable of the second

mypy_errors.why: gaps.md G3 — soft since it was added, which is how it reached 238

pytest_skip_sites.basis: skipif + bare skip + runtime pytest.skip() across tests/
pytest_skip_sites.why: a skip reads as a pass in every summary line — gaps.md G2

pytest_slow_marked.why: excluded from CI by -m 'not slow', so each one is CI coverage given up
